headline: October 15: Equity allocation caution, gasoline-driven retail headline and rising crude

facts.event: BlackRock Investment Institute shifts U.S. equities overweight to neutral and short U.S. Treasuries to overweight
September retail sales headline 0.8% versus 0.2% excluding gasoline stations; gasoline stations 6.4%
Reuters midday WTI futures quote $98.05, up 3.11%, on October 15

live_cross_reference.description: Compare these published news events with source-timestamped SPY and oil observations; the quote feed may use different contracts and timestamps than reported news quotes.

thesis: Whipshaw documents the tension between oil-driven nominal retail sales, household cost pressures, defensive asset-allocation research, and equity price response.
